speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) how do the absolute and relative costs – as a percentage of total expenses – of owning or renting property borne by SMEs and startups in Singapore compared to countries with a strong startup and SME sector, including Germany, Switzerland, Israel, Japan and the USA.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
text: In absolute figures, the median rental per square foot per month in the last quarter of 2017 was about $9 for office space in Core Business areas and close to $5.50 in other areas; almost $10 for retail space in Orchard Road and about $5.50 in other parts of the Central area.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
text: For industrial space, the median rental per square foot per month in the last quarter of 2017 was about $2 for a multiple-user factory space and about $4 for Business Park space.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
text: To ensure that there continues to be sufficient flow of commercial and industrial space to meet demand and support economic growth, the Government releases land for private-sector developments through the Government Land Sales (GLS) programmes.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
text: JTC also develops innovative industrial facilities with shared services to help SMEs reduce capital expenditure and operating costs.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
text: To support startups, JTC has developed startup clusters known as LaunchPads.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
text: As startups may have different space requirements, JTC offers options ranging from bare units to units with air-conditioning and ready power provision.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
text: The startup community has taken well to the Launchpads.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
text: The Government will continue to closely monitor the industrial and commercial property markets and ensure the stability and sustainability of rentals for businesses over the medium to longer term.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: The Minister of State mentioned that the rental costs are comparable to major cities in the US, Japan and Switzerland.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: I think in some of these countries, SMEs may have the option of moving to the outskirts of the city and renting industrial property or even light industrial or commercial properties.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: I am not sure if that has been factored into the statistical comparison that the Minister of State mentioned.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: So, my question is: will the Ministry consider studying the comparison between rental costs here and rental costs in key cities in these other countries, including the outskirts, and monitor that and study if that level of rental costs that we have is serving as an impediment to entrepreneurship or people wanting to continue in SMEs going forward.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: We are beginning to create more space for new entrepreneurs to start their businesses and Launchpads for innovation.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: I think that has been well received by entrepreneurs.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: JTC will continue to look at the demand and if there is more demand, we will see how best we can create some spaces for innovation and Launchpads for entrepreneurs to take off.
